overview: Dr. Englund is an Assistant Professor in the Department of Medicine - Division of Gerontology, Geriatrics, and Palliative Care. He earned his doctorate degree in the Center for Muscle Biology at the University of Kentucky and continued his research training as a Postdoctoral Fellow in the Kogod Center on Aging at Mayo Clinic. Dr. Englund joined UAB in 2024.
